_comment: Sample trades for the Money Program daemon. Drop this into money-program-trading/data/trades.json (overwriting or appending to the trades array). Only the 'trades' array is read; top-level comment keys like this are ignored by the loader but preserved on save.

_schema.price_convention: US stocks: prices in DOLLARS (e.g. 390.00). UK stocks: prices in PENCE (e.g. 116.0). stake = £ per point (1 point = 1 cent for US, 1 pence for UK).

trades.notes: SAMPLE — VCP breakout off 50DMA, RS 92, ADX 31
SAMPLE — S-B breakdown, distribution 4/10 days, RS 22
SAMPLE — pence prices. UK spread bet. Stake 1.2 £/pt = £1.20 per 1p move
